A.l_ INTRODUCTION

This Appendix contains summary sheets for all the post-1900 earthquakes listed in
Table 2 of this document. In each sheet, the seismic parameters collected from various
sources are listed. Where the surface-wave magnitude of the earthquake has been re-
calculated, the data used in the calculation and the results are shown in the summary sheet.
Brief descriptions of the earthquake are also given where relevant information is available.

Explanatory notes on the layout of the summary sheets and the symbols used are given
in the following sections. All the symbols are defined in the Glossary.
